text_block_list.text:
To check Silence Suzuka's progress,
I decided to time her runs today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing if you've gotten faster.
I'm looking forward to seeing if you've gotten faster!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... How was my time...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My legs just wanted to keep moving forward and forward,
and they simply wouldn't stop.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, distant scenery felt so much clearer than before,
it felt really wonderful...!

It seemed the steady coaching of Silence Suzuka
was truly paying off.
